based_on: A-v1 (identical data, model revision, head, length, precision, optimiser and selection rule)
development_note: Draft. Grids may change only after a source-only pilot (IMDb validation, no test or target predictions); freeze with python -m sc4001_b.freeze before formal runs.
data_content_reference: ../member-a/remote-records/data-v1/manifest_hashes.json (all entries except datasets state.json/dataset_info.json must match)

methods.M4: stage 1 = frozen-encoder linear head (Member A's M1 with A's selected M1 LR for the same cell, retrained here); stage 2 = full fine-tuning from the stage-1 model
methods.M6: full fine-tuning + lambda * mean(1 - cos(pool(h_theta), pool(h_0))) on the same labelled batch; pool = mean over non-padding final-layer token states; h_0 = frozen pretrained encoder
methods.L2SP: control: full fine-tuning + lambda * 1/2 * ||w_encoder - w0||^2 (Li et al. 2018); AdamW weight decay 0.01 kept as in all methods

inherited_learning_rate.M6: selected M3 LR of the same budget-seed cell
inherited_learning_rate.L2SP: selected M3 LR of the same budget-seed cell
inherited_learning_rate.M4S1: selected Member A M1 LR of the same cell

selection: IMDb validation accuracy; earliest checkpoint for tied epochs; protocol list order for exact candidate ties; lambda = 0 (= M3) is not an M6/L2SP candidate
test_access: Per cell, only after its selection file is written: winners of every method, and every M6/L2SP lambda candidate as a pre-registered ablation. IMDb official test, Yelp 5000, Amazon 5000 via Member A's locked evaluate.py
retention: Keep configs, metrics, histories, logs, predictions and winner best/ models; remove recovery checkpoints, nonwinner weights (after evaluation) and stage-1 weights.
